label: Avs III system
definition: An AVAST system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded subtype III locus represented by DefenseFinder with Avs3A and Avs3B profiles.
observations: Avs subtype III branch under AVAST system; distinct from the broader AVAST system, individual Avs3A or Avs3B proteins, individual DefenseFinder Avs_III profile rows, unresolved Avs III effector chemistry, Avs I through Avs II and Avs IV through Avs V subtypes, and other phage-defense systems.
